observations: body L1: «§ 2.» is bold; the dash after it measures 9.6 pt.
body L4, L7, L13, L28, L35: «Arabico–occidentali» (5.9 pt), «274–277» (5.4 pt), «Arabico–occidentalibus» (5.9 pt) and «63,v.–64,r.» (4.9 pt) have long dashes; the hyphen of «11-12» measures 3.2 pt.
body L10-L11: «Graffin» and «Nau» are letter-spaced; «lx» is in small capitals.

body L18-L23: the Arabic words, read at 600 dpi: «عديرة» with ʿayn and «غديرة» with ghayn; «قرنس», «القريس», «لادقية» and «اوريقى» with the qāf of two dots; «فرندس» and «اوروفي» with the fā of one dot above; «اوروفي» ends in the yā with two dots, «اورنقى» and «اوريقى» in the yā without dots.

body L26: the second Arabic word, «الغرس», is printed with the medial ghayn: the solid wedge of the ʿayn of «العريش» on the same line, with a dot above; the medial fā of this type is a round loop (as in «الفرس» of the notes on the tables, t. II, p. 215). The word is transcribed as printed; the transliteration «al-Furs» and the sense («Persae») give الفرس.
body L31: a dot below the first i of «interpolationibus» is a speck.
notes_left L4-L5, notes_right L1: «Schiaparelli» and «Dozy» are letter-spaced; the guillemet after «(3)» prints thinner than the others.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
